policy: Same as v6; general bonding, RAM keys, no MITM, auto_accept remains disabled
trace_scope: Allowlisted host/controller HCI metadata only, not air capture; at most 96 trace records; no keys/addresses/raw packets
limits: HCI controller failure is not proof of remote culpability
Host dump precedes transport and does not prove air transmission
Legacy main capture may contain device addresses and stays private
